event: Inception, as the audited statement-period label prints it
evidence_class: FACT about the audited header; registrant-retrospective about the event
notes: The earliest date any held Tier-1 carrier attaches to this company. Nothing in the corpus dates the decision to found (P1G01)

event: Sold 4,303,000 Series A preferred shares at $0.50, net of $22,000 of issuance costs
notes: Year-only date per §13 partial-date rule. Purchaser identities are P1G02 and are the single highest-value gap in the stage

event: Tench Coxe (Sutter Hill Ventures) and Mark A. Stevens (Sequoia Capital) become directors
notes: Weeks after inception; the only sign of outside capital inside the founding year. bios also date Stevens's Sequoia general-partnership appointment to March 1993

event: Harvey C. Jones, Jr. becomes a director
notes: Jones also appears as a personal signatory on the 1997 Ex-4.3 shareholder pages

event: Sold 2,390,831 Series B preferred shares at $1.80, net of $57,000
actors: the Company; Sequoia and Sutter Hill named as parties to the December 1994 agreement they descend from
notes: Price 3.6x the 1993 round

event: Original Investors' Rights Agreement entered into - the earliest in-window date attached to named outside investors anywhere held
actors: the Company; JAFCO, Sequoia and Sutter Hill entities, others
notes: Recited inside Ex-4.3 (1997). The instrument itself of 1994 is NOT held; only its recital and its successors' signature pages are

event: Amendment Number One to the Investors' Rights Agreement
notes: Same recital chain

event: Sublease Agreement with Amdahl Corporation for 432 Lakeside Drive, Sunnyvale; amended 1995-03-01 and 1995-09-01
actors: NVIDIA Corporation; Amdahl Corporation; landlord Oakmead Investments
notes: Third-party-dated facility evidence. The exhibit's defined-terms header prints label/value drift, so roles are taken from the operative paragraphs

event: First product, the NV1, introduced
notes: Two years and one month after inception. No launch collateral, datasheet or press item is held (P1G09)

event: Sold 416,667 further Series B shares at $1.80 and 750,000 Series C at $6.67 net of $14,000
notes: The Series C price is the 1995 peak against which the 1997 down round is measured

event: NV1 sales stopped in the first quarter of 1996; NV2 console development ceased; RIVA128 development began
notes: DISPATCH-PREMISE CORRECTION: the probe dossier rendered this quarter as 1997. Both held drafts print 1996

event: Second Amended and Restated Investors' Rights Agreement executed; Company signed by Jen-Hsun Huang, President
actors: the Company and the Shareholders including Sega Enterprises, Ltd., Itochu, Worldview Technology Partners I, JAFCO, Sequoia and Sutter Hill entities
notes: The single best documentary carrier of the private period in the corpus

event: Sold 1,438,812 Series D preferred shares at $5.26, net of $30,000 - priced 21% below the 1995 Series C
notes: Filed price fact about how hard the middle years were; needs no retrospective narrative

event: RIVA128 graphics processor introduced; commercial shipment and first revenue of the current product line in the third quarter of 1997
actors: the Company; ST Microelectronics as manufacturer and licensee
notes: Company assertion of a first-in-family design; no independent launch coverage held

event: Low manufacturing yields at ST, the quarter the company first reported net income
notes: The only incurred operational failure inside the window on this evidence

event: Fiscal year-end changed to a 52/53-week year ending the last Sunday in January; prior December-31 periods not restated
notes: Every 1993-1997 figure in this volume sits on the pre-change calendar basis

event: Certificate of Incorporation of NVIDIA Delaware Corporation subscribed by sole incorporator Mitchell R. Truelock of Cooley Godward LLP
notes: A shell for a reincorporation announced as prospective; the operative amended charter in the same filing is still a blank-dated form

event: Form S-1 filed, File No. 333-47495; offering price in its own pro forma footnote left blank
actors: the Company; underwriters named in later drafts
notes: EDGAR floor for this registrant and the end of the structural silence

event: Two Form RW (registration withdrawal) filings appear in the index in the same month as an amendment
notes: Indexed, never fetched; an unexplained withdrawal inside the stage and the clearest example of a named UNTRIED event, not a null

event: Period-end used for the last Stage-1 balance sheet and headcount (184 employees); mandatorily convertible notes of $11.0M outstanding
notes: The last measured state inside the window

event: Final prospectus dated; 3,500,000 primary shares; Nasdaq symbol NVDA; closing on or about 1999-01-27
actors: the Company; Morgan Stanley, Hambrecht & Quist, Prudential Securities
notes: STAGE 1 CLOSES HERE. Everything after is (PB)

event: First amendment after the S-1 adds the SGI patent infringement suit to the record
actors: the Company; Silicon Graphics Inc. as plaintiff
evidence_class: FACT-about-the-printing; the suit itself is a pleaded matter
notes: SGI token count moves 4 to 44 between the March and April drafts - the amendment cycle is the clock for this event

event: Company notified that S3 had filed a second patent infringement suit, alleging three patents
location: San Francisco / Northern District of California
notes: Enters the record only with the 1998-11-20 amendment, six months after notification - a disclosure lag, not an event date

event: Company notified that 3Dfx had filed a third patent suit, directed at the RIVA TNT product
notes: 3Dfx token count moves 4 to 40 in the same amendment. The company answered and counter-claimed that the patents are invalid and uninfringed, relying on an opinion from named outside patent counsel

event: Three major customers lend the company 11.0 million dollars on non-interest-bearing subordinated convertible notes
actors: the Company; three unnamed major customers
evidence_class: CONTEMPORANEOUS disclosure of an instrument; holders unnamed
notes: The channel financed the balance sheet. Second tranche in August 1998. No note instrument or counterparty schedule is filed

event: Company enters a noncancelable operating lease for its facilities running through 2002
notes: The successor to the Amdahl sublease of 1995; the registrant's address of record had already moved from Sunnyvale to Santa Clara by this draft

event: Amendment discloses that TSMC is now the primary manufacturer and that assembly and test run through Amkor and Siliconware
actors: the Company; TSMC; Amkor Technology Inc.; Siliconware Precision Industries Co. Ltd.
evidence_class: FACT about the printing; the switch itself is registrant-narrated
notes: Also the draft in which the company states that leaving ST's manufacturing ends ST's patent umbrella and will increase infringement risk

event: Amendment discloses 3Dfx's pending acquisition of STB, the company's largest customer, and forecasts a significant reduction in sales to it
evidence_class: FACT as disclosed; forward-looking against interest
notes: The first held draft containing the phrase sales to STB will be reduced significantly (3 hits, 0 in every earlier file)

event: Competitor list revised: VideoLogic, Evans and Intergraph and SGI added to the professional tier; Chromatic dropped because ATI acquired it; Micron (an OEM customer) is recorded as having acquired Rendition
actors: the Company; ATI; Chromatic Research; Micron; Rendition
evidence_class: FACT about the printing; reported consolidations
notes: Consolidation is the registrant's own word for the state of the field: highly fragmented and undergoing a period of consolidation

event: Nine-month customer mix reported as STB 40 percent, Diamond 28 percent, Creative 12 percent
notes: Fiscal basis (38 weeks). Creative also lent into the July-August notes if the three noteholders are AIB houses - an inference the corpus does not support

event: Manufacturing commitments of 48.0 million dollars disclosed alongside a 5.0 million dollar drawn line of credit and 4.5 million of gross lease payments
notes: The commitment figure is the scale of purchase orders a fabless company carries into an offering; cash at the same date was 12,461

event: Form 8-A12B filed - registration of a class of security on a national exchange, thirteen days after the S-1
notes: Indexed with a blank primaryDocument and NOT stored; an 8-A before effectiveness is a sequence question worth a fetch, not a null

event: Two Form RW registration withdrawals filed in the same month as an amendment
actors: the Company; unnamed registrant of the withdrawn statement
notes: Part 1 named this UNTRIED item 10; still unfetched. A withdrawal inside a live registration is an event

event: Form S-1MEF filed the same day as the 424B4
notes: A merger of registrations filed with the final prospectus; the only held index row for it has a blank primary document

event: Schedule 13G filed by Creative Technology Ltd and CTI Limited reporting 2,192,785 shares, about 7.5 percent
actors: Creative Technology Ltd; CTI Limited; NVIDIA Corporation
notes: Used in the §T ledger and for no Stage-1 claim. It is the only counterparty-authored description of this registrant anywhere in the corpus

event: One month ended January 26, 1997: revenue 190, net loss (522) - the smallest reported revenue period in the corpus
notes: Restates part 1's P1K05 finding: the period is a printed column with values, not an orphan footnote string with none

event: One month ended January 31, 1998: revenue 13,331, net income 1,347 - the first profitable reported period
notes: Ends the calendar-January year-end step; the 52/53-week convention begins February 1, 1998 (P1K13)
